proposed_question.text: Under the general RA 9514 RIRR means-of-egress rule, what minimum width applies unless a specific occupancy division provides otherwise?

rationale.correct: Section 10.2.5.2 paragraph F states that the width of any means of egress shall not be less than 915 mm except when specifically provided under Divisions 8 through 20.

distractors.A: 760 mm appears in other dimensional contexts but is not this general minimum.
distractors.B: 815 mm is not the cited general egress minimum.
distractors.D: 1120 mm appears in the stair capacity equation context, not as the general minimum egress width.

rationale.takeaway: Keep the general width minimum separate from stair-capacity and occupancy-specific rules.
